name: Report Writing
description: Ability to produce clear, accurate, and structured technical reports documenting security findings, evidence, risk ratings, and remediation guidance. Covers engagement reports, evaluation reports, and forensic reports, including the reporting requirements of ISO/IEC 17025:2017 clause 7.8 (e.g. clearly identified opinions and interpretations).

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to technical report writing

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the purpose and structure of security reports
evidence: Has read and reviewed example security reports
Can identify the key sections of a findings report

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Can draft report sections under supervision; work reviewed before delivery
evidence: Has drafted findings write-ups reviewed by senior staff
Can document a vulnerability with description, impact, evidence, and remediation

3.label: Independent Practice
evidence: Reports pass QA review with minimal corrections
Appropriate risk ratings and remediation guidance

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Produces complex reports; reviews others' work; improves templates
evidence: Handles multi-domain and complex engagement reports
Performs QA review on junior staff reports
Contributes to or maintains report templates and style guides

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines reporting methodology; trains teams; handles sensitive deliverables
evidence: Designed the lab's report framework and standards

assessment_methods.description: Review of 3 recent engagement reports authored by the individual
Draft a findings report from a provided set of raw engagement notes
